Subject: Hosted API renewal — surge pocket & SLA amendment

Hi Rebecca / Ignite team,

Thanks again for the productive renewal call last week. As discussed, we've prepared an updated SOW and an amendment that reflects the higher committed monthly throughput you requested, plus a temporary "surge pocket" to cover the expected marketing spike in Q3. Key points in the attached SOW (IGNITE_SOW_v2.pdf):

- Committed monthly tokens: 3.5B (up from 1.8B)
- Burst / surge pocket: 500M tokens per month for 3 months (billed at discounted overage rate)
- New rate bands for hosted API (per-token pricing by tier) included in Appendix A
- Soft-throttle policy: 95th-percentile latency SLO 220ms; soft-throttle enabled above agreed sustained burst thresholds
- SLA exception: one-time surge accommodation (no auto-throttle) during the 30-day campaign window if PO and DocuSign executed by 2027-07-10

Next steps I propose:
1) Review SOW and the short redline amendment I attached as a Word draft (we'll finalize legal wording after we align on commercials).
2) Confirm procurement timeline and whether you can get a PO to us by 2027-07-09 so we can guarantee the surge pocket.
3) If agreeable, we'll send the DocuSign for signature and provision the dedicated rate band in your account (no infra changes required on your side).

Can you confirm the expected start date for the marketing push? If it's earlier than 2027-08-01, we can front-load the surge pocket but will need earlier PO.

Appreciate a quick confirm — happy to hop on a short call today if you prefer.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Mateo —

Thanks for the materials. High level we like the approach and the temporary surge pocket should cover our Q3 launch. A couple quick clarifications before we loop procurement: 

- Can you confirm the per-token overage rate that will apply to the surge pocket once the 500M allotment is exhausted? We need this for internal modeling.
- For the soft-throttle policy: can you provide the guardrails in plain terms (i.e., at what sustained TPS do you trigger soft-throttle vs. hard throttle?)
- Legal will want a 60-day termination notice for the amended term — is that feasible?

Procurement asked if we can get a final number for the first three months (commit + expected overage) so they can issue a PO. Assuming we use 60% of the surge pocket in month 1, what's the expected billable?

If those answers look fine we'll ask Procure to prepare the PO and get back on the DocuSign timing. I can do a 15-min call tomorrow morning if that helps.

Thanks,
Rebecca Li
Head of Product, Ignite Labs

Mateo / Kim —

Looping in our commercial mechanics and legal head to keep this tight with Ignite. Answers to Rebecca's questions below (we'll include these as plain-language bullets in the amendment):

- Overage rate: $0.00025 per token for surge pocket overage (discounted from standard $0.00035). We applied a 29% discount for the temporary burst window.
- Soft-throttle guardrails: soft-throttle engages when a sustained 60-second moving average exceeds 1,200 TPS per customer account for more than 2 minutes. Soft-throttle reduces per-request concurrency and enforces polite backoff headers; it does not drop requests. Hard throttle only fires when sustained 1,800 TPS for > 1 minute and is a last-resort circuit breaker. We'll include the exact metrics in Appendix B (observability hooks + recommended client retry policy).
- Termination notice: we can accept a 60-day termination notice for the amendment, but only for the amended term window (not the base contract). We'll flag this to Legal for the final redline.

Also recommended: offer a one-time onboarding credit of $8,000 (applied as invoice credit across first two invoices) to help transition to the higher commit and offset initial overage risk. If Ignite agrees, we should bake that into the DocuSign and PO memo.

I've attached a short redline (redline_amendment_draft.docx) with the updated guardrails and the credit line — Kim, please review and confirm legal language before we send to Rebecca.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
